page_convention: Printed page numbers; PDF page is printed page + 1 for both documents.
important_corrections: 0x020B directly supplies sentry with ally ground positions at 1 Hz; these do not all require radar forwarding.
0x0305 5 Hz limit concerns radar-to-operator minimap; it does not set all sentry observations or decisions to 5 Hz.
0x0A01..0x0A06 originate at 10 Hz at signal source; actual sentry availability depends on radar decoding and permitted forwarding.
10 Hz policy inference is allowed; lower-rate sources require held/estimated observations, not slower whole-policy inference.
Self onboard sensing can exceed referee position frequency; actual hardware performance is not available in this repository.

communication_differences.required: 30 Hz shared maximum uplink; 112 byte content, <=127 byte total packet; sentry/radar receive round(5120*(1-base_hp_lost/20000)) bytes per 1000 ms
communication_differences.current: 4 messages of <=512 JSON bytes per decision; unrestricted roster routing and next-round delivery; no shared packet budget or base-HP scaling

communication_differences.required: Sentry can receive multi-robot interaction data only from radar; separate referee downlinks remain permitted
communication_differences.current: generic TeamCommunication can route ground teammate messages to sentry directly; radar excluded from roster

communication_differences.required: module connectivity check 2 Hz; offline cuts relevant communication
communication_differences.current: physical failures not randomly simulated; no observation availability scheduler for these failures

communication_differences.required: mark updates depend on radar sending; 0.5 s gaps count as errors; 0x020C and 0x020E update radar at 1 Hz
communication_differences.current: radar and marking mechanisms explicitly excluded

communication_differences.required: 0x0303 event; >=0.5 s between commander sends, >=3 s for semi-auto operator; four additional copies every 100 ms then last packet at 1 Hz
communication_differences.current: commander intervention and semi-auto explicitly excluded

communication_differences.required: actual camera/estimator produces detections at configured rate with errors/occlusion and processing delay
communication_differences.current: geometric visible check then exact state; no camera pipeline; official terminal video 60 fps is not the onboard detector frequency

communication_differences.required: Rulebook p66-p67 disables operator FPV after heat threshold; local autonomous sensing is a separate source
communication_differences.current: visibility based on simulated muzzle camera; overheat reduces effective vision to 0.35 rather than representing separate FPV/video and local sensor streams

available_but_not_explicitly_encoded.note: Some ratios already encoded; some fields used by scripted execution but not by MLP.

available_but_not_explicitly_encoded.note: Adapter design requirement for faithful partial observations, not mandatory official packet fields.

already_matching: Heat cooling and power-buffer settlement at 10 Hz (season2027.rs:607,705).
RFID deactivation 2 s hold exists (season2027.rs:865; rulebook p102).
Sentry posture switch 5 s, decay 180 s, enhanced budget 15 s implemented; missing MLP information is separate from rule implementation.
Self HP/heat/ammo/gold nominal input rate 10 Hz is compatible with relevant protocol downlinks.
caveat: Missing network features are not automatically illegal or required. Scripted controller and navigator also read raw observation; fixing only the 152 feature encoder cannot by itself establish real-robot equivalence.

representation_differences.evidence: lib.rs initializes legacy energy=0 and no simulation source updates it; portable.py prioritizes this present key over buffer_energy_j
ammo>500, heat>max_heat, own gold>5000 all saturate at 1; this is lossy representation, not an official prohibition
precise current/required progress exists in terminal RobotRespawnStatus (1 Hz), while onboard 0x020D reports confirmation/payment eligibility; no proven direct onboard equivalent
one boolean primarily represents chassis availability, not independent chassis/gimbal/shooter outputs
policy uses chassis heading; official 0x0203 angle is muzzle velocity module heading in degrees from north
not in 0x0101 nor 0x0A04; terminal-only information must not be assumed available onboard
training-only flat_jump annotation, zero in normal match
no per-field age/validity and no distinction between unobserved, stale, zero or derived values
0x0003/0x0A02 provide current HP, not each target max_hp; own max_hp is available through 0x0201
corresponding standard ground-robot protocol positions are reserved; six-slot data layouts must not be interpreted as real values for all six slots; individual drones are absent from the MLP vector
